headword: {六法全書|ろっぽうぜんしょ}
gloss: compendium of laws; complete book of the Six Codes

definitions.gloss: compendium of laws; complete book of the Six Codes
definitions.explanation: A comprehensive reference volume that collects the texts of the major Japanese statutes, centered on the Six Codes ({六法|ろっぽう}). A standard tool for law students and legal professionals.

examples.japanese: {六法全書|ろっぽうぜんしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{条文|じょうぶん}→条文：16622_joubun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: to look up a statute in the compendium of laws.

examples.japanese: ⟦{法学部|ほうがくぶ}→法学部：24334_hougakubu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧みな{六法全書|ろっぽうぜんしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: Law students all own a compendium of laws.

examples.japanese: ⟦{分厚|ぶあつ}い→分厚い：10502_buatsui⟧{六法全書|ろっぽうぜんしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧はいない⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{引|ひ}いて→引く：01978_hiku⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: No one reads the thick compendium of laws from the beginning; people look things up in it like a dictionary.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{六法|ろっぽう}→六法：06612_roppou⟧ (the Six Codes) + {全書|ぜんしょ} (complete/comprehensive book). A thick, dictionary-like volume collecting statute texts; also the title of well-known published editions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {六法全書|ろっぽうぜんしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to look something up in the compendium
- ⟦{分厚|ぶあつ}い→分厚い：10502_buatsui⟧{六法全書|ろっぽうぜんしょ}: a thick compendium of laws

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{六法|ろっぽう}→六法：06612_roppou⟧: the Six Codes — the collection of core statutes themselves, as opposed to the printed volume
- {判例集|はんれいしゅう}: a casebook — a companion volume collecting court precedents
